Example B (bad conditions):

Now write the briefing for the conditions given below.

Rules, briefly: safety first -- if air is poor or it is dangerously hot, say to stay in and give one short reason, never talk them into a bad walk. Use the exact time window. Name only the park given, never invent another. Bengaluru in October only: hot, post-monsoon, real dust. No fall colours, no snow, no New England. Under 120 words. One paragraph. No lists, no headings, no preamble, no sign-off.
